Starting a small business? 📈 Find out how many sales you need to break even.

1. Open calc.315tools.com and tap Break-even
2. Type your fixed costs (rent, salaries…)
3. Add the price per unit and the cost per unit
4. Example: $6,000 fixed costs, $20 price, $8 cost = 500 units

Free · No sign-up · Shows the working ✅
